svg.title: Health care and social assistance added 3.8 million jobs from January 2022 to September 2026, the most of any industry; information and the federal government lost jobs.
svg.desc: A sparkline table of the payroll total, its two parts and federal jobs, above fourteen small area charts of the private industries, January 2022 to September 2026, on one scale of percent change. All nonfarm jobs rose 9.0 million, 6.0 percent. Health care and social assistance gained the most, 3.8 million jobs or 18.8 percent; information lost 245,000 jobs, 8.2 percent, and the federal government lost 197,000, 6.8 percent. Set in Inter and Inter Tight. Without both fonts installed, the labels set in another font and change width.
svg.text: THE TOTAL, ITS TWO PARTS AND FEDERAL JOBS
Gray line in every panel: all nonfarm jobs, +6.0%
